summary: BUG-0166: Share only simultaneous identical native GFS metadata reads. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: Internal read-path correction; operator workflows and required safety checks are unchanged.

api.reason: API impact: existing contract. Concurrent callers of the same exact-device metadata query can share its fresh successful result; completed results are not retained, each caller retains its context, and full protocol/table/journal/identity validation remains required. Controller-facing schemas and retries are unchanged.

roadmap.reason: Reliability work within the current storage milestone; no published capability or milestone status changes.

state.reason: No new durable state, pool setting or execution authority. Existing Core-owned records and inventory adoption remain authoritative; temporary in-flight read results are discarded on completion.

verification.method: The concurrent-query regression failed with the old direct-read behavior. Fixed same-device fan-out, no completed-result reuse, different-device independence, waiter cancellation/deadline and failed-leader fallback checks passed. Full vmhost normal/race and agent/vmhost normal checks passed. Independent implementation review and separate focused normal/race checks passed. The combined diagnostic candidate passed affected normal/race tests, build and independent artifact review; its sequential three-Core rollout passed. That partial BUG-0165/0166 candidate retained three distinct Core3 idle deadline observations; it had no loaded run. Clean-candidate idle/loaded verification remains pending and no deadline elimination is claimed.
